description_en: Searches the government document library based on complex conditions
description_zh: 根据复杂条件进行政务公文库的检索
name: ListDocumentRetrieve

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the Bailian workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The content type. Valid values:
0 (null): All. This is the default value.
1: Official document.
2: Important article.
5: Policy interpretation.
6: Legal provision.
7: Regulation.
8: General Secretary
parameters.help_zh: 文章体裁，0（null）:全部(默认值),  1：公文，2：重要文章  5:政策解读 6：法律条文 7：规章法规 8：总书记
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en:
The secondary content type classification. Valid values depend on the content type:

When ContentType is 8 (General Secretary):
1: Updates.
2: Speeches.
3: Thoughts.
4: Theories.

When ContentType is 1 (Official document):
-1: Other.
0: Resolution.
1: Decision.
2: Order.
3: Communiqué.
4: Announcement.
5: Notice.
6: Opinion.
7: Notification.
8: Bulletin.
9: Report.
10: Request.
11: Reply.
12: Motion.
13: Letter.
14: Minutes.

When ContentType is 2 (Important article):
1: Important commentary.
2: Important theory.
3: Other articles.

When ContentType is 7 (Regulation):
3: Administrative regulation.
4: Supervisory regulation.
5: Local regulation.
7: Departmental rule.
8: Other.
9: Party constitution and rules.

When ContentType is 6 (Legal provision):
1: Constitution.
2: Law.
6: Judicial interpretation
parameters.help_zh:
文章体裁二级分类，文章体裁为总书记时：1：动态 2：讲话 3：思想 4：理论
     * 文章体裁为公文时：-1： 其他 0：决议 1：决定 2：令 3：公报 4：公告 5：通告 6：意见 7：通知 8：通报 9：报告 10：请示 11：批复 12： 议案 13：函
     * 14： 纪要
     * 文章体裁为重要文章时：1：重要评论 2：重要理论 3：其他文章
     * 文章体裁为规章法规时：3：行政法规 4：监察法规 5：地方性法规 7：部门规章 8：其他 9：党章党规
     * 文章体裁为法律条文时：1：宪法 2：法律 6：司法解释
parameters.name: sub_content_type

parameters.help_en: The region. Enter a province or city name directly, such as Jilin Province or Beijing
parameters.help_zh: 区域 可直接输入 省 或者市 如吉林省 或者北京市
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The source. Valid values:
0: Internal (own organization).
1: External (other organization)
parameters.help_zh: 来源，0：内部（本单位） 1：外部（外单位）
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The start date of document issuance, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of document issuance, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The search scope. Valid values:
1: Title only.
0: Full text (title and content). This is the default value
parameters.help_zh: 检索要素范围，1:标题  0:全文(标题和内容)，默认
parameters.name: element_scope

parameters.help_en:

| Primary category | Secondary category |

| Comprehensive Government Affairs | 20th National Congress, Government Transparency and Supervision, Joint Government Affairs, Party Building, Meetings and Proposals, Government Document Management, Other Government Affairs |
| State Council Organizations | State Council, General Office of the State Council, State Council Agencies |
| Administrative and Market Regulation | Administrative Regulation, Credit Regulation, Product Quality Supervision, Work Safety Regulation, Market Regulation |
| Economic Management | National Economy, Market Economy, Economic System Reform, State-owned Asset Supervision |
| Finance, Banking and Commerce | Finance, Banking, Audit, Commerce, Customs |
| Personnel and Social Security | Personnel Work, Population and Family Planning, Women and Children Affairs, Poverty Alleviation, Disaster Reduction and Relief, Public Services, Social Welfare and Assistance, Veteran Resettlement, Social Security |
| Public Safety and Social Management | Public Security, Safety, Judiciary, Fire Services, Ethnic Affairs, Religious Affairs |
| Science, Education, Culture and Sports | Culture, Science and Technology Innovation, Education, Intellectual Property, Press and Publishing, Broadcasting and Internet, Sports, Tourism |
| Healthcare | Public Health, Medical Services, Veterinary Medicine |
| Urban-Rural Development and Industrial Development | Urban-Rural Development, Industry, Transportation |
| Natural Resources and Environmental Protection | Land Resources and Energy, Civil Engineering, Meteorology, Environmental Protection |
| Agriculture, Forestry, Water, Fishery and Animal Husbandry | Agriculture, Forestry, Water Resources, Fishery, Animal Husbandry |
| Other | Other |
